notes.title: Evil Seal Update 1.2.1 - Enhancements and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
🔥 Dear players,

I'm excited to announce the release of Evil Seal update 1.2.1, which brings a series of enhancements and bug fixes based on your valuable feedback. I continue to work hard to ensure that your gaming experience is increasingly engaging and satisfying. Here's a preview of the changes made:

🎧 Cassette Tape Bug Fix: I've resolved an issue that occurred after solving the cassette tape puzzle. Now, the focus correctly shifts away from the recorder after the conversation between Adam and the demonic entity, ensuring a smoother gaming experience.

🚀 Improved Shotgun Reload Speed: I've increased the reload speed of the shotgun by 25%, making combat with this weapon even more dynamic and gratifying.

🏃 Increased Sprint Frequency: You can now sprint more frequently while running, improving movement speed and reducing the time required to reach new areas.

😈 Enhanced Devil Hitboxes: I've optimized the hitboxes of the devil during its area attacks and movements, ensuring greater precision and consistency in interactions during combat.

👁️ Improved First-Person Experience: Significant improvements have been made to the first-person experience by eliminating Adam's head rotation when rotating the camera. This enhances immersion during FPS gameplay.

🎯 Enhanced Weapon Accuracy: Weapons are now more accurate, providing a more satisfying and tactical combat experience.

I thank you once again for your continued support and feedback. I'll continue to closely monitor your comments and work to continually improve Evil Seal. Enjoy taking on the new challenges that await you!

In addition to the number of monsters killed, you can now earn achievements for your most epic accomplishments, such as eliminating enemies with precise headshots or defeating them with finishing moves. I'm thrilled to offer you these new experiences and I'm grateful for your continued support. Please keep sending me your feedback and suggestions, as they are crucial to making Evil Seal even better.

Thank you for playing Evil Seal and have fun! 🎮

notes.title: 🎮 Evil Seal Update 1.1.7 Now Live! 🎮
notes.notes:
I'm thrilled to announce that the latest update for Evil Seal, version 1.1.7, is now available! This update brings several improvements and fixes to enhance your gaming experience. Here's what's new:

First-Person Gameplay Enhancement: I've revamped the first-person gameplay experience. Your character's head is now fully visible, providing a more immersive perspective. The camera has been repositioned in front of the character's head and stabilized to ensure smoother movement and a more enjoyable gameplay experience.

Stereocassette Puzzle Bug Fix: I've addressed a bug in the second level's stereocassette puzzle that prevented the use of key items on the stereo, making progression inaccessible.

Ghost Behavior Fix: The behavior of ghosts has been adjusted to properly pursue the player character when attempting to escape, providing a more challenging and engaging encounter.

Devil's Attack Adjustment: I've reworked the Devil's ground pound attack to eliminate unrealistic behavior while maintaining its danger, ensuring a more realistic and thrilling gameplay experience.

Second Ghost Fix: I've resolved an issue where encountering the second ghost and retrieving a key item before defeating it would prevent its appearance upon game reload, preserving the intended progression and challenge.

Scene Lighting Calculation Optimization: I've improved the speed of scene lighting adaptation to eliminate delays and ensure seamless transitions, enhancing overall visual quality and immersion.

Dodge Mechanism Fix: I've addressed an issue where the character would perform unintended rolls in certain situations while attempting to dodge, ensuring more responsive and accurate movement.

I'm committed to delivering the best possible experience for our players, and this update is just one step towards that goal. Thank you for your continued support, and happy gaming!

Raffaele Mandese

notes.title: 🛠️ Evil Seal - Hotfix 1.1.4 Now Live! 🛠️
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

I'm excited to announce the release of hotfix 1.1.4 for Evil Seal! This update addresses several issues reported by our community and includes some exciting improvements. Here's what's new:

🔧 Fixes:

Fixed an issue where the ticket behind William Black's painting in the second level would not always display the interaction widget.

Corrected an error where the tape recorder puzzle in the second level would unlock incorrectly under specific circumstances.

Thank you for your patience and support as I continue to improve Evil Seal! I hope these fixes enhance your gaming experience. Don't hesitate to reach out if you encounter any further issues.

Happy gaming!

Some players encountered character blockages during the inspection of certain puzzles. This has been addressed to ensure smoother puzzle-solving.

I've resolved the occasional unintended switch from third-person to first-person view during combat scenarios.

- I've made various tweaks and optimizations across the game to enhance your overall gaming experience.

notes.title: Evil Seal - Update 0.5.6 Now Available!
notes.notes:
I'm thrilled to announce the first major update for Evil Seal! Listening to your feedback, I've been hard at work to enhance the gaming experience in several significant ways. Here's a sneak peek of the changes made in this update:

🎮 1. More Spectacle, More Fun
I've amped up the action in some key areas of the game, adding new elements like explosive barrels to make them even more spectacular and enjoyable to explore.

💾 2. Manual Save System
You asked for it, and now you can manually save your game progress. Never lose your advancement again!

📷 3. Camera Shake Control
You have complete control over the camera shake caused by your character taking hits. Customize your gaming experience to your liking.

👤 4. Improved First-Person View
Now, in first-person mode, you'll be able to see your character's entire body, except for the head, which remains hidden during most movements to avoid obstructing your view of the surrounding environment.

🚶 5. Realistic Movements
I've improved the collision system, eliminating the unpleasant invisibility effect during final movements of your character.

🔍 6. Clear Guidance
I've added clearer widgets that indicate the locations of puzzles, documents, items, and doors in the environment to help you explore and solve puzzles with ease.

🗺️ 7. Enhanced First Level Map
The map of the first level has been significantly improved for smoother navigation.

🎈 8. Streamlined Experience
For those who want a slightly more accessible challenge, I've reduced the damage inflicted by monsters in easy mode.

🏃 9. Improved Stair Movements
I've eliminated the annoying camera shake when the character descends stairs, ensuring a smoother transition.

🎯 10. Precision Shooting
I've fine-tuned the first-person aiming system, so now you can hit your enemies with greater accuracy.

👹 11. More Responsive Enemies
I've improved the reaction of minor demons to your shots, creating a system that hinders their movements based on the weapon and shots used.

🐞 12. Bug Fixes
I've addressed various minor bugs related to puzzles to ensure a smoother gaming experience.
